=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:946-956 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: _review_stall_verdict does not recognise the ai:review-skipped label as a deterministic skip. When ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false, a deterministically skipped claude/* PR has ai:review-skipped applied by the gate but no auto_merge object. After CLAUDE_REVIEW_STALL_HOURS the checker reports review-stalled and dispatches a redundant review, contrary to the requirement that deterministic skips be excluded.
  WHY: A properly skipped doc-only or small-diff claude/* PR enters the review-stalled path, wastes a fixer session and a dispatched review, and after the redispatch completes without trace sets stall_redispatched=true, which forces a hold requiring operator intervention.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:388-414 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _dispatched_review_runs reads only the newest 100 workflow_dispatch runs in a single page. It does not compare total_count against the page length or page further, unlike _complete_dispatch_run_listing (line 494) which the active-run count already calls. A completed redispatch older than 100 runs can fall off this single page, leaving _verified_review_redispatch unable to find it.
  WHY: If a repo accumulates more than 100 review dispatches between the stalled head's arrival and the stall check, a completed redispatch for that head becomes invisible. stall_redispatched stays false, another review is dispatched, and the stall-redispatch loop runs extra cycles before timing out. The practical window is wide (2 hours per stall check, 100 runs needed) but the active-run path already paginates for correctness in the same script.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:841 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: _head_has_review_trace scans only lines[-2:] for the FIXER_HANDOFF_RE marker, while _check_claude_fixer_pr (line 626) scans every line. The handoff comment format today places the marker on the last or second-to-last line, so the narrow window works. An intervening blank line after the marker or a format change would push the marker beyond the window.
  WHY: A comment line added after the handoff marker would cause an already-reviewed head to be reported as having no review trace, which lets _review_stall_verdict fall through to the stall check.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: _head_has_review_trace() returns None for any PR head whose hand-off comment carries both ledger digest and verification markers.
